claims.text: The FDA dimenhydrinate label says concomitant alcohol use may have an additive CNS depressant effect.
claims.quote: The concomitant use of alcohol or other central nervous system depressants may have an additive effect.

headline.text: The FDA dimenhydrinate label describes possible additive CNS depressant effects with alcohol.

reported.text: The label includes alcohol among CNS depressants that may have an additive effect with dimenhydrinate.
